provenance: RECORD-TIER anchor (019 doctrine: deviations are reported, never gated). Single-session first-hand measurement, 2026-07-11, owner's Diamond Pro-Am 9-ft (catalog geometry diamond_proam_9ft, independently confirmed by the diamond-sight homography at 0.33-0.38 mm RMS), one uncharacterized cue, one striped training ball standing in for the cue ball; iPhone slow-motion VFR originals on the exact per-frame pts clock (pipeline v3 definitive; v1/v2 bake-clock numbers retracted). Full session, method, uncertainty and adjudication record: docs/verification/pool-9ft-measured-calibration.md (audit trail: GitHub issue #5). Anti-overfit doctrine (constitution P-IV): this data legitimizes ONLY the opt-in Measured-tier catalog entries (owner_proam_9ft_2026_07 / owner_proam_cloth_2026_07) and these record-tier anchors; it is NEVER grounds to change global kernel defaults. Cloth quantities: mu_slide from two-phase position-domain fits (n=4, bootstrap sds 0.0013-0.0050), mu_roll is SPEED-DEPENDENT (0.0086 @ 0.3-0.55 m/s vs 0.01195 @ 0.8-1.1 m/s - reporting a single u_r would hide real structure), spin decay alpha from stripe-phase PLL spin-downs (scale-free, exact clock). KNOWN GAP: below ~3-5 rad/s the windowed-slope estimator cannot exclude a softer spin-decay tail.
title: Cloth friction - owner's table, v3 definitive (exact per-frame pts clock)

metadata.ball: striped training ball standing in for cue ball (c0-slide: blue-striped cream training ball ~10-ball; c0-spin: hand-twist spin-in-place releases, no cue)

mu_slide.method: position-domain piecewise-constant-deceleration fit s(t): phase-1 slide (a1 = mu_slide*g) -> phase-2 roll, continuous s and v at t*; g = 9.81 m/s^2; whole-ball geometric-center tracking (stripe-rotation-immune); bootstrap (residual resampling, 300x) per-shot sds
mu_slide.regime_note: launch v0 1.96-2.25 m/s with heavy backspin (draw, omega0 -64..-59 rad/s inferred from v*/v0 = 0.470 +- 0.012); Coulomb slide deceleration is spin-independent; single a1 per leg - no mu_slide vs slip-speed resolution (slip speed spans ~2-4.5 m/s in phase 1)

mu_roll.method: single-phase constant-deceleration roll fit on post-cushion return legs (natural spans only; cue-disturbed tails trimmed per v3 frame audit); cross-check: s04 full-settle distance identity gives 0.0089 vs fit 0.0089
phase-2 (post slide->roll transition) of the two-phase outbound fit; same tracking and bootstrap as mu_slide

mu_roll_speed_dependence: rolling resistance rises with speed: 0.0086 @ ~0.45 m/s -> 0.0120 @ ~0.95 m/s (confirmed on exact clocks; v1 saw the same trend). Reporting a single u_r would hide real structure.

alpha_rad_s2.method: hand-twist spin-in-place releases (no cue), 4 spin-downs; per-frame blue-stripe-mask principal-axis orientation, PLL-unwrapped BACKWARD from rest (branch-unambiguous); omega(t) = local slope over ~1-revolution windows on a 20 ms grid; exact pts clock; rotation quantities are scale-free (no homography needed)
alpha_rad_s2.regime: constant-alpha Coulomb-like decay holds down to ~5 rad/s; no distinct low-omega regime (alpha(omega<15) = 8.8 +- 0.7 vs alpha(omega>25) = 9.1 +- 0.3 rad/s^2); below ~3-5 rad/s an apparent soft landing is not separable from windowed-slope smoothing

u_sp_equiv.source_inconsistency_note: results-c0-spin-v3.json states u_sp sd 0.00054 in u_sp_equiv but '+/- 0.00052' in kernel_comparison prose; structured field adopted

spin_decay.kernel_comparison: measured alpha 9.1 +/- 0.5 rad/s2 vs kernel default 10.90 (u_sp_scale 0.4444, params.rs): owner's cloth spins ~17% longer than the shipped default and ~2.4x longer than the 22 rad/s2 literature anchor for other cloths. Equivalent u_sp_scale for THIS cloth: 0.370 +/- 0.018 (u_sp = 0.01056 +/- 0.00052).

literature_context: mu_slide 0.247 sits at the top of the 0.178-0.245 range quoted for other cloths; mu_roll 0.009-0.012 normal (pooltool default u_r=0.01). Catalog entry with provenance — not a global-defaults change.
